marco: Quick follow-up from AH on spend guardrails. Couple of practical Qs from infra: 1) If we sign a 90-day prepaid vendor for cheaper inference, does that need exec sign-off? 2) Who owns the negotiation for SLO/exit terms?

yuki (Eng): Also 1) can we split payments (50/50) to avoid big upfront runway hits? 2) any preferred contractual language to request credits?

maria (CFO): Short answers: exec sign-off required for commitments that annualize to >= $50k run-rate. For 90-day prepay, we annualize the monthly-equivalent. Payment-splitting is acceptable if vendor agrees; include payment schedule in FIN-450 intake. Procurement (cc @nikki) owns negotiation for SLO/exit clauses.

dylan (Finance Ops): For the intake, include: expected unit-cost delta, cash impact by month, cancellation windows, and owner. Use FIN-450: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-450. We target 48-72hr for standard, 24hr for expedited labeled "cost-savings".

nikki (Procurement): When negotiating credits, ask for: (a) SLA-based service credits, (b) partial refunds on early termination, (c) rolling credits if utilization falls below a threshold. Example clause: "Provider shall issue monthly service credits equal to X% of fees if monthly utilization < Y%."

yuki (Eng): Good example, thanks. Marco: can infra own initial negotiation or must Procurement lead from day 1?

marco: We prefer to move fast on PoC deals. Who should sign NDA and initial MOU?

nikki (Procurement): Procurement should review/approve NDAs and MOUs. For speed, we can use a pre-approved NDA template and sign asap; DM me the vendor and I'll expedite.

maria (CFO): Quick policy note: P-card not for prepaid multi-month commitments. P-card ok for one-off purchases <= $5k. For prepaid pilots > $5k, use FIN-450 intake.

people-ops: Any headcount implications we should flag when committing to a new vendor that might reduce infra costs?

maria (CFO): If a strategic cost optimization could change headcount plans, include a note in the intake and loop in People Ops early. Role-by-role hiring still goes through Hiring Committee. No company-wide freeze today but approvals are tighter.

yuki (Eng): If we propose a split payment (e.g., 50/50), will Procurement accept a PO for the remainder?

dylan (Finance Ops): Yes, we can structure initial payment via expedited procurement and capture the remainder as a PO or scheduled invoice. Capture payment schedule in FIN-450 so FP&A can model runway.

marco: Action items: 1) infra to draft FIN-450 with two utilization scenarios (base/stress) and payment schedule; 2) Procurement to push for credits/exit windows; 3) Finance to model runway impact on submission.

procure-bot: Created FIN-450-1: "90d prepaid inference vendor evaluation" and assigned to nikki.

sam (CEO): High-level: we support tactical prepaids that materially improve unit economics and speed product delivery. Just keep Finance/Procurement in the loop before signing cash commitments. :white_check_mark:

marco: Thanks team 44d I'll submit FIN-450 with the two scenarios and tag it "cost-savings" for expedited review.
